name: cbox-app
description: Cbox — Responsive Social Chat App + Installable Android PWA (GitHub + Render Ready)

scripts.build: npm --workspace=backend run db:generate && npm --workspace=backend run build && npm --workspace=frontend run build
scripts.render:build: npm install --include=dev && npm --workspace=backend run db:generate && npm --workspace=backend run build && npm --workspace=frontend run build
scripts.render:start: npm --workspace=backend run db:migrate && npm --workspace=backend run start
